scope: Separate fresh 2x and matched 1x upper-glancing captures, with 1 warm-up and 3 measured stable-power replays each. Not normal-clock baseline timings or GPU busy time.

rendering.aa: Renderer-wide Current default, r_silpomAntiAliasing=0; SMAA disabled
rendering.sample_selection: Process-start r_multiSampleCount=2 matches project default; 1 is a separate forced comparison

limits: No AMD hardware counters: GPUPerfAPI reports Hardware Not Supported.
No per-function, instruction, occupancy, cache-miss or stall-duration ranking.
Event times under stable power and replay instrumentation are not the 182 ms normal-clock pass.
Counter PS invocations and Samples Passed are not unique output pixels or individual invocation latency.
CPU coverage assumes standard Direct3D 2x sample locations for quality zero; not queried vendor locations.
CPU model excludes in-draw depth evolution, hardware Hi-Z and helper lanes.
No off/on experiment, shader edit, shader rebuild, recovery/default change or optimization.

main_hit_draws.note: Programs assigned through exact captured-bytecode matching to shader templates; wall-backup draw list excluded. Per-round sums precede medians.

proxy_model.scope:
Reconstruct captured proxy coverage at explicit 1x/standard-2x sample sites.

This CPU model is not a hardware PS-invocation simulation. It excludes in-draw
depth evolution, Hi-Z granularity and helper lanes. Quality-zero 2x is modeled
with the Direct3D standard pattern; that pattern assumption is recorded.
proxy_model.sample_pattern_note: Pixel center at 1x; assumed standard Direct3D 2x pattern for captured msQual=0; not a queried vendor sample-location table
